item.title: Assistant Superintendent Of The Year!
item.description: Chillicothe R-II School District Assistant Superintendent Dr. Brian Sherrow was named the Northwest Missouri Association of Administrators Assistant Superintendent of the Year! Superintendent Dr Dan Wiebers spoke about the recognition. Says he has many responsibilities. He’ll be recognized in March at the MASA State Conference.

item.title: Dixie Lee Christison
item.description: Dixie Lee Christison, age 85, a lifelong resident of Chillicothe, Missouri, passed away on Friday, January 9, 2026, at her residence. Dixie was born the daughter of Carl and Pearl Lula (Martin) Schwab on March 19, 1940 in rural Chillicothe, Missouri. She graduated from Chillicothe High School in 1957. item.title: Troopers Arrest Gallatin Man For Alleged DWI
item.description: A Gallatin man was arrested by State Troopers in Caldwell County Friday evening. Thirty-year-old Steven R. Johnson of Gallatin was arrested for alleged DWI – prior offender. He was taken to the Caldwell County Detention Center on a 24-hour hold.
